blocks.body:
name = "acme/clock-bad-7"
version = "1.0.0"
[agent]
timeout = "30m"

[sandbox]
timezone = "America/New_York"
clock = { start = "2026-03-14T09:00:00-04:00", enforce = "preload" }

diagnostics.message: a set clock needs network = "none" while it runs, and [sandbox] network is "open" (the default): the network tells the real date (TLS, HTTP Date headers, package mirrors). Set [agent] network = "none"
